messages.snippet: Dear Sirs, We act for Hartwell Pharma Limited. Please find attached our letter before action concern
messages.subject: Hartwell Pharma Limited — Letter before action
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Sirs,

We act for Hartwell Pharma Limited. Please find attached our letter before action concerning the supply of defective batch TX-HX218-0461 under the Supply and Quality Agreement dated 14 February 2024.

We should be grateful for your acknowledgement within 14 days and a substantive response within 28 days. If you have instructed solicitors, please pass this to them.

Yours faithfully,
Sarah Whitfield
Whitfield Carter LLP

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

Dear Ms Whitfield,

Thank you for your letter, receipt of which is acknowledged. We have passed it to our solicitors, Thackeray Wolfe LLP (Robert Mason), who will respond. We do not accept the claim as framed.

Regards,
Gerald Doyle
Technical Director, Tessaract Bioreagents Limited
